date.as_written: nepāla sammatetra grahaturagamunāvaṃkite caitramāse śuklatithyāṃ hi rudre maghasahita yute yogarāje ca śūle | vāre vāgīśvarākhye

notes: The chronogram graha-turaga-muni reads 9-7-7 (NS 779). The scribe Vīrabhadra is described as kṣitipatikulajaḥ ('born of a royal/kṣatriya lineage'). Śrīpati refers to the deity Viṣṇu.
